thread:
Maya (CS): Quick dump from yesterday's onboarding calls — collecting short verb snippets we can hand to product.
Sam (CS): Nice, drop them here. I'll tag priority ones. :clipboard:
Maya (CS): Customer A: 'we need a per-route toggle for embeddings' (uses embeddings heavily for search)
Maya (CS): Customer B: 'make the embed exports incremental, we can't re-run full jobs'
Sam (CS): Customer C: 'need clearer per-API cost breakdown on console'
Jordan (Product): Thanks — any concrete workflows or pain examples?
Maya (CS): Customer A workflow: nightly ingestion -> embedding -> upsert. Pain: reshaping embeddings is full-run and blocks nightly window.
Anita (Onboarding): Saw same w/ Customer D — they tried dedupe, but re-embedding kills their SLA.
Sam (CS): I'm marking incremental-embed-request as HIGH for customers on Dedicated.
Maya (CS): Customer E: 'onboarding docs assume webhooks are instant; we need retry/backoff guidance'
Liam (Eng): For incremental exports/embeddings, there's a couple backend knobs (batch delta, resume tokens). ETA on a proposal?
Jordan (Product): Can you add estimated impact (# customers, renewal risk) for each ask? Helps prioritization.
Maya (CS): Quick numbers: incremental embeddings would unblock 3 pilots (>$50k ACV total), one flagged renewal risk if unresolved.
Sam (CS): Cost-breakdown ask affects >10 accounts, mostly SMB pilots — lower ACV but widely requested.
Anita (Onboarding): Webhooks retry docs is a small win, low effort. I can draft a short KB and examples this week.
Jordan (Product): Great. Liam - can you sketch a 1-page feasibility note for incremental embeddings? Even rough perf tradeoffs.
Liam (Eng): I'll draft — include expected CPU/GPU delta and storage impact.
feedback-bot: New ticket created: FEAT-1872 incremental embeddings (reported by Maya).
Maya (CS): Added sample logs/ingest manifest to the ticket.
Sam (CS): For next steps: Anita -> KB by Thu, Liam -> feasibility by Fri, Jordan -> triage decision next Mon. @product-team please weigh in if timeline misaligned. :calendar:
